opening.argument: The material promotes an easy AVAX flash-loan arbitrage method while directing viewers through a concrete funding and deployment process. It instructs viewers to “On Deploy, Enter your token details and deploy the contract” and then to “Send $200 of Avalanche/AVAX to the contract for gas fee for all swaps.” The speaker further claims that “the rapid trading inflates the coins value and that inflated value is where we generate the profit,” presenting the method as capable of rapidly increasing about $200 to about $1,775 through trading. Although the description says, “This worked for me. But TRY IT AT YOUR OWN RISK,” that disclaimer does not verify the contract's behavior or establish the claimed outcome, recoverability, or any actual return.
